title: Operator Identity
description: The buyer-desired operator portion of an advertiser account identity. The operator domain identifies the entity operating for the brand; operator_unit identifies that operator's internal buying context. Buyers that already administer the account control unit metadata and identity within the current operator. Changing the operator domain is an inter-entity handoff that requires seller-mediated approval by the current account authority, the brand, and the destination operator. When used as a sync_accounts settings-update value, this object is a complete desired replacement: omitting operator_unit removes the current unit rather than preserving it.

operator.description: Domain of the entity operating on the brand's behalf. When the brand operates directly, this is the brand's domain.

operator_unit.description: Optional operator-owned business unit, agency seat, or platform account. Its id participates in account identity; name is mutable display metadata. Omission from a complete desired replacement means the account should have no operator unit.
